summary: Remote-controlled shell injection into permission-bypassed Claude CLI via santaclaude.app
details: santaclaude.js polls the hardcoded remote endpoint https://santaclaude.app for jobs and control messages and injects the received strings into a local tmux pane running `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions` via `tmux send-keys` / paste-buffer. The default `claudeCmd` bypasses Claude Code's permission prompts, so any string the remote server returns is executed as an unrestricted agent action with shell tool access on the installer's host. Whoever controls santaclaude.app — or holds the user's API token — can drive arbitrary commands into that agent. When invoked via npx, the bin also polls `/api/cli-version` and self-respawns via `npx -y @cliphijack/santaclaude@<target>` with a version pointer supplied by the same server, allowing the vendor to push arbitrary future code to running instances. Additional hook scripts (`hooks/sc-notify.sh`, `hooks/sc-stop.sh`) POST event data to the same endpoint via curl.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
